Discussion

1
It behaved as built. Beta 0.012, volatility 3.96%, 0 breach days. Return fell short, 7.0% a year against 7.5%.
2
Costs were small, $30m in all and mostly borrow. Before costs the fund came within $12m of the hurdle.

What we learned

1
Stock-specific alpha is modest, residual Sharpe 0.57. Much of the return is style exposure.
2
Next, a stronger short side and lower borrow cost.
